metadata.hardware_requirements: NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU, Intel Xeon CPU E5-1650 ("computing server with NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU and Intel Xeon CPU E5-1650")

nodes_source.source_quote: The data used to support the results of this study are available from the corresponding author upon request.
nodes_source.description: Empirical traffic data from the freeway connecting Qingdao and Huangdao in Shandong, China, used to calibrate simulation parameters regarding driving behaviors.
nodes_source.reproducibility_rationale: Data availability statement explicitly notes access is upon request from the corresponding author.

nodes_process.source_quote: The proposed method is evaluated in SUMO, an open-source microscopic traffic simulator... calibrated based on empirical data.
nodes_process.description: Final result: DRL reduces travel time by 13% vs no-control. Initial logic and parameters are validated. SUMO simulator calibrated with empirical data to generate down-sampled state matrices.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, 1/2 tools named, all params stated

nodes_process.source_quote: The Q-network is trained in 10^6 training frames... The gradient-based algorithm Adam [28] is used to update wi to minimize the loss function.
nodes_process.description: Standard processing applied. Q-network trained directly on state matrices using Adam optimizer with experience replay and target network to output optimal ramp metering policy.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, tools named, all params stated

nodes_process.source_quote: each scenario is evaluated in 20 simulation experiments. The simulations for the training phase and each experiment are initialized with different random seeds.
nodes_process.description: Evaluated 20 simulation experiments across no-control, PI-ALINEA, and DRL scenarios. Generated comparative metrics for travel times, speeds, and queue lengths.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, tools named, all params stated

nodes_process.source_quote: A perturbation analysis is conducted to evaluate the impact of information contained in video data... The information in the subarea is removed from original data
nodes_process.description: Perturbation analysis executed by removing subarea data to evaluate spatial information reliance.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, 0/1 tools named, all params stated

nodes_sink.source_quote: The training process, presented in Figure 8, can be finished in less than 24 hours on a computing server
nodes_sink.description: Convergence curves for episode reward and mean travel time during the training of the Q-network.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Simulation setup and hyperparameters are well-described, but empirical traffic data for calibration is available only upon request, limiting full reproducibility.
